book.title: Complete I Ching
book.subtitle: Detailed explanation of 64 hexagrams
book.aboutZhouyiContent: The I Ching, also known as Zhouyi, is one of the classic Chinese traditional texts. It is traditionally attributed to King Wen of Zhou. It consists of two parts: the Classic and the Commentaries. The Classic mainly contains 64 hexagrams and 384 lines, each with their explanations (hexagram texts and line texts) used for divination. Known as the "leader of all classics," the I Ching contains profound philosophical thoughts and cosmology, and has had a profound influence on Chinese culture.
